MIT 3.071 Amorphous Materials, Spring 2025
Instructor: Juejun Hu
This lecture covers glass optical properties (refraction, dispersion, Abbe numbers), loss mechanisms (absorption, Rayleigh scattering), and coloring with ions or through photochromic/electrochromic effects.
